## Venue

Evolutionary Computation Theory and Applications (IJCCI / ECTA), 2023.
:::

::: {.content-block}
## Abstract

This paper studies speech command recognition and proposes a Differential Evolution based search strategy for CNN hyper-parameters. The goal is to reduce manual tuning cost while improving classification quality on the Google Speech Commands dataset.
:::
